WITH budget_spending AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_budget,
    SUM(cost) as total_spent,
    COUNT(*) as expense_count
  FROM expense
  GROUP BY link_to_budget
),
avg_spend AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_spent) as avg_value
  FROM budget_spending
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    bs.total_spent,
    bs.expense_count
  FROM budget_spending bs
  WHERE bs.total_spent > (SELECT avg_value FROM avg_spend)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(total_spent) as average_total,
  SUM(expense_count) as total_expenses,
  AVG(total_spent) - (SELECT avg_value FROM avg_spend) as average_exceeds
FROM above_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Expenses with NULL link_to_budget are excluded from analysis (standard SQL GROUP BY behavior excludes NULLs).
